h: The Journey to the Land Through Refined Middos

p: אַחַד עָשָׂר יוֹם מֵחוֹרֵב וְגוֹ׳ (דְּבָרִים א, ב)
they would have entered the land, etc.
they would have entered the land, etc.
they would have entered the land, etc.
as soon as the soles of their feet came up from the sea
they would have entered the land,
as it says: 'Go up, possess,' etc."
We need to understand the dispute of the Tanna'im:
so how can all the verses be upheld?
Also, from Chorev to Kadesh Barnea
is a journey of eleven days,
as stated explicitly in the verse;
so what does "had they been worthy" mean
"within eleven days they would have entered"?
But all of it is true.
For in truth they were fit
before the sending of the spies (Devarim 1:21):
as Hashem, the God of your fathers,
But preparation is needed for this:
for the creation of the world,
and the middos are called days,
as the holy Zohar points out
כִּי שֵׁשֶׁת יָמִים עָשָׂה ה׳ וְגוֹ׳
and it is not written "in six":
corresponds to the middah of Malchus.
"and his heart will understand, and he will return";
precedes the seven days of Creation.
is the utterance "Let there be light,"
corresponding to the five Chumashim of the Torah."
וְאִיתָא (וַיִּקְרָא רַבָּה רֵישׁ פָּרָשָׁה יט, יט, א)
the Torah preceded the creation of the world,
and the day of HaKadosh Baruch Hu
that precede the seven days of Creation,
and they are the aspect of two days.
וְכֵן נִדְרָשׁ (זֹהַר חֵלֶק א קכט, א)
And so it is expounded (Zohar I 129a):
that is, the three upper ones,
for on this depends the faith above:
and in the Field of Apples
(כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב זֹהַר חֵלֶק ב פח, א)
that is, the whole Name Havayah
with the tip of the yud,
which alludes to the ten middos,
וְזֶה עִנְיַן מַה שֶּׁאָמַר רַבִּי יְהוּדָה
And this is the matter of what Rabbi Yehudah said:
"Had Yisrael been worthy, within three days
they would have entered the land,
'And the Aron of the covenant of Hashem traveled before them
to seek out a resting place for them.'"
for which the Avos are a chariot,
and they are branches of the three upper ones.
And the holiness of the Avos
stands against the three heads of the kelipos,
which is the kelipah of Amalek,
who was lowly in all his affairs
And this is what is said:
"to seek out a resting place for them"
that is, to merit Eretz Yisrael,
as is written in the Sifrei:

p: And what the first Tanna said,
"had they been worthy, within eleven days
they would have entered the land," etc.,
is according to what is written
And they explained "ten and not nine"
as referring to the middah of Malchus:
that it is not included among the ten Sefiros;
עַל זֶה אָמַר עֶשֶׂר וְלֹא תֵּשַׁע
on this it says "ten and not nine,"
is included among the ten Sefiros,
הַשּׁוֹכֵן בְּתוֹךְ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל (בְּמִדְבַּר לה, לד)
who dwells in the midst of the Children of Yisrael" (Bamidbar 35:34).
they explained as referring to the middah of Daas,
which is the inner dimension of Keser Elyon.
That is, it is the fiftieth gate
of the fifty gates of Binah,
which is given over to the baal teshuvah.
And this is what it says
וְכָל יְקָר רָאֲתָה עֵינוֹ (אִיּוֹב כח, י)
"'And his eye saw every precious thing' (Iyov 28:10)
this is Rabbi Akiva and his colleagues";
for he was the root of
Torah she'b'al peh, as is known,
that comes to repair the "abundance of anger";
and it corresponds to the chelbenah in the ketores,
it too gives a good fragrance.
And this alludes to the transgressors of Yisrael
he too gives a good fragrance.
And lest you say that this makes eleven,
for the middos of Keser and Daas
only that the baal teshuvah merits
the fiftieth gate, which is Daas,
to Moshe Rabbeinu, peace be upon him
And this is what it says
"Things that were not revealed to Moshe
were revealed to Rabbi Akiva and his colleagues";
in the aspect of a baal teshuvah,
When I was an am ha'aretz," etc.
the intellect hidden from all thought.
That is the Torah she'b'al peh,
and it is called halachah l'Moshe mi'Sinai.
And as we will merit in the future,
"for they shall all know Me," etc.
that they will merit Torah she'b'al peh
in the aspect of Written Torah.
And this is what it says (Nedarim 22b):
they would have been given only
the five Chumashim of the Torah," etc.,
which is the Torah she'b'al peh
And this is what it says (there):
"for it is the arrangement of Eretz Yisrael";
for "land" is the middah of Malchus,
we call it Torah she'b'al peh
and he merits the fiftieth gate,
the inner dimension of Keser Elyon.
and knowledge will be pleasant to your soul";
and this comes from the teshuvah
And this is what it says:
that even the aspect of Daas
is included among the ten Sefiros,
and it is the inner dimension of Keser Elyon.
And this is what it says in the Sifrei:
within eleven days they would have entered";
together with the middah of Daas
had Yisrael been refined in them,
And this is why it says in this parshah
for they needed to be refined
together with the middah of Daas.
"Had Yisrael been worthy, within one day
they would have entered the land,
'And it shall be when He brings you,' etc."
And the measure is one day,
and he did not say immediately,
at the moment they left Egypt
a moment is equal to a thousand years.
Yisrael came out of one kelipah
into the middah corresponding to it.
they came out of the tenth kelipah,
into the middah of Keser Elyon,
for they are bound at the root,
And this is the meaning of
they were refined on that day
in the middah of Knesses Yisrael
And this is why he said "within one day
that is, the middah of Malchus,
for which Knesses Yisrael is a chariot;
and this is what is said (Shemos 6:7):
"And I will take you to Me as a people," etc.
as soon as the soles of their feet came up
they would have entered the land,
as it says: 'Go up, possess,' etc."
even though this was said at Kadesh Barnea.
that immediately at the splitting of the Sea,
(in the Mechilta and the holy Zohar, Beshalach):
And this is in the manner of what is written
the alef bored through the darkness
and there in the Song it is written (Shemos 15:17):
"You will bring them and plant them."
"And they went out into the wilderness of Shur";
and as is written in the holy Zohar
And afterward, at the Giving of the Torah,
And this is what is said:
"And the Aron of the covenant of Hashem traveled before them
to be refined in the three middos
which stand against the three heads of the kelipos
"to seek out a resting place for them":
that they were fit to merit afterward
they had already been refined in the middah of Malchus,
in all the ten Sefiros within it.
when it was spoiled with the Calf,
then they needed to be refined
the ten Sefiros together with the middah of Daas,
And this is what is said:
and there Moshe said to them:
as Hashem, the God of your fathers,
for you were already fit to go up
from when the soles of their feet came up from the sea,
after they were refined in the middah of Malchus
on the day they left Egypt,
and they were refined in all the ten Sefiros
Thus all the words of the Sages
וּמַר אָמַר חֲדָא וּמַר אָמַר חֲדָא
one master said one thing and the other master said another,
as it says in the pesukim mentioned.
But through the corruption of the spies
and Hashem Yisbarach brought upon them
as is written in the Sifrei.
You have given to Your people."
which one merits by keeping Shabbos,
and the yetzer hara is cleared out from there
the lower Shabbos and the upper Shabbos
